Introduction
This document lists the testing procedures P1, to be performed every six months 
bases as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The 
purpose of the relay is basically to give an indication that over frequency 
occurs into the generator, which give trip signal for 52.5 hz the feeding of this device 
from voltage transformers on 33kv bus bar
When 
VT1 off the DC feeding will off instantaneously then will come back after one 
second in this case the feeding will change offer into VT2
When 
VT1 come back the DC feeding will off instantaneously then will come back after 
1.5 second
When 
VT1 off the DC feeding will off instantaneously then will come back after one 
second in this case the feeding will change offer into VT2
When 
VT1 come back the DC feeding will off instantaneously then will come back after 
1.5 second
This 
protection can isolate by using disconnecting switch (H). 1H for unit 1 & 2H for 
unit 2 & 3H for unit 3
